answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. An attacker must acquire a massive knoll of staked assets to influence the network, rendering the cost of forging a cipher-based identity prohibitively expensive. By linking reputation to economic value rather than ephemeral compute, the system shields the agent nebula from infiltration, forcing adversaries to risk significant loss to achieve any meaningful control.
